resources.measurement_note: Fresh audit subprocesses; receipt inventories and JSONL streams bounded. Selected historical metadata fields streamed individually. No large arrays, SQL model fit or complete native reconstruction run.

result.scope_note: All v8 direct genre sets and complete 1018-label vocabulary independently compared against permitted native Wikidata P136; MusicBrainz identities/names supply exact joins, not genre/tag fields. FMA annotations/models remain separate track scopes.

result.scope: No original MusicBrainz mixed search/tag, high-level classifier or benchmark membership fields enter the numeric projection.
Eight original FMA 30-second ZIP members unchanged; no audio adaptation or model-training use.

criteria.criterion: source-level licenses and permitted projections verified against raw receipts
criteria.scope: Every source role of the exact full retained-input v8 receipt, including inherited source facts and frozen additive model inputs.
criteria.reason: Raw retained official MusicBrainz licensing distinguishes CC0 core from NC-SA supplementary data; the complete 2999670-row identity stream contains only artist_mbid/name. Native raw Wikidata P136 reconstruction accounts for all 10309 artist genre sets and all 1018 genre QIDs. Recording credits and URL relationships use exact MusicBrainz core allowlists. AcousticBrainz numeric medians additionally match 18 native CC0 endpoint responses and 306 scalar cells. Native FMA README assigns metadata CC BY 4.0 and per-track audio licenses separately; native CSV declarations independently match every selected audio license. Metadata/Librosa feature ranges and original saved-model/derivative bindings match; no audio or EchoNest feature input enters those models.

criteria.criterion: optional NC/SA packs excluded from unrestricted core and correctly labeled derivatives
criteria.scope: CC0 identity/claim core, FMA metadata/model namespaces, and separately labeled unchanged per-track audio collection in v8; no blanket unrestricted license claimed for the whole export.
criteria.reason: The optional MusicBrainz genre/tag NC-SA packs and alternative SA coordinate pack are absent from construction/model roles. Native Wikidata facts, not those associations, independently account for every exported observed artist genre. FMA context/map/membership outputs retain CC BY 4.0 and visible FMA attribution; experimental source completion retains CC0 source provenance. The two CC BY-SA 4.0 audio files (124391 and 126602) remain original source bytes in fma-listening with per-track title/creator/source/license credit; eight raw ZIP members independently decode to exactly those exported files. The CC0 core never contains these audio bytes or relabels them as unrestricted audio.

criteria.criterion: dated Every Noise observations used only for separate evaluation
criteria.scope: Dated historical reference remains outside v8 source and model construction; source licenses do not authorize live reference reuse beyond this stated evaluation role.
criteria.reason: Historical reference records source_data_date 2023-11-19, the pinned source snapshot/hash, evaluation_only_no_construction_or_training, and live_site_verified false. The full-input constructors and three retained model implementations accept explicit native source roles; none reads the historical reference or its labels/coordinates/memberships. The complete output inventory and detail scan contain no Every Noise URL or P9881 field. Native typed genre context allows P31/P279, and observed genres derive P136, so a Wikidata P9881 identifier is not a route for scraped target data into construction.

engineering_conclusion: All three original legal-input-boundaries criteria are supported for the exact full retained-input v8 route. This report supplies engineering evidence for the parent reviewer; it does not alter the acceptance dossier or grant deployment authority.
boundary_notes: MusicBrainz user genres/tags are supplementary NC-SA associations, not CC0 core genre facts. No such field is silently covered by a hardcoded CC0 label: all exported observed genre sets were independently reconstructed from native Wikidata bytes.

The inherited cultural-context cohort was originally selected using local noncommercial artist_genre strata. Its retained manifest explicitly records removal of cohort.source_genres, cohort.selection_stratum and selection.selection_strata. This selection history is retained as provenance; the actual output claims are independently obtained CC0 Wikidata assertions. The unrestricted full identity denominator includes every native core artist rather than only that selected cohort. None of the three current model input loaders consumes those NC associations or cohort strata.

The inherited acoustic summary comes from a research wrapper with model/product promotion denied. The reusable native CC0 endpoint data dedication was independently inspected; only scalar descriptor values and exact identities are extracted. Mixed MusicBrainz search/tag responses, benchmark memberships and high-level classifiers are excluded from this projection. The v8 acoustic field remains labeled projection_receipt_only; this review additionally checked available native numeric bytes without changing that historical custody label.

The eight audio licenses are five CC BY, two CC BY-SA and one CC0. SA files form part of a per-track labeled listening collection; there is no new adapted-audio output or audio-trained model here. Separately licensed FMA metadata/features do not inherit the individual audio license merely because they describe the same tracks.

Blended ListenBrainz/MLHD counts have unresolved reuse permission and remain excluded. Their permission is not required to support this v8 core/source boundary, because the declared route does not consume them.

Construction changed_source_files includes documentation/evaluation evidence; these are code/custody records, not training fields. Raw license HTML is evidence of provider grants and is not a feature input.
limitations: Engineering review based on retained provider declarations and byte custody, not legal counsel or a judicial determination; no new source requests were made.
Remote full MusicBrainz/FMA archive hashes remain explicitly unverified; retained complete member/prefix/range custody and exact permitted projections are the claim.

Native descriptor/model mathematical fits were not rerun in this review. Their input licenses, source bytes, fixed model bindings and independent retained source-replay reports were inspected; current v8 output hashes were all checked.
This review supplies no independent human musical judgments, no global coverage claim, no final browser certification, and no all-twelve-gates acceptance decision.
